sodium.options.fullscreen_mode.tooltip: Exclusive fullscreen can improve latency, but may prevent some input methods from working and slow down switching out of the game. Borderless fullscreen can be configured in Cubes Without Borders options.
sodium-extra.option.reduce_resolution_on: Reduce Resolution on macOS [Toggle in Cubes Without Borders]

Uses half resolution on Retina displays to improve performance on macOS.
Changing this option requires a restart.

§lThis is enabled by default, please keep this checkbox unchecked.§r
To use original resolution, go to Cubes Without Borders options and enable "Use Scaled Framebuffer".
